name: omp-skilld
description: An unofficial OMP plugin that refreshes skills from GitHub repositories in the background
author: Attacktive

omp.name: Skilld
omp.description: Keeps skills from GitHub repositories up to date in the background

sources.description: GitHub repositories to refresh skills from, as a list such as "anthropics/skills, someone/their-skills", or JSON for per-source overrides (repo/target/stamp/label/placeholder)

interval.description: How often to refresh, in milliseconds
